description: Recent insider transactions of a US company parsed from SEC Form 4 filings: who (name, role: CEO, director, 10% owner), what (buy, sale, grant, option exercise), date, shares, price, value and holdings after, plus totals of open-market purchases and sales. Price: $0.02 per successful call via x402 (eip155:8453); 5 free calls/day across all tools.

limit.description: Number of latest Form 4 filings to parse (default 10, max 20)

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B
